page.notes: Stray small marks in the left margin (near the lines beginning "nominis", "Nihil" and "Quænun") and a small mark at the right edge are not printed text and were left out. "Quænun:" is doubtful and may be a worn or misprinted word. "erroreorum" is read from a worn line and is uncertain. The last line of text "& tus-" is low on the page, so it was taken as the catchword. The Greek and other words are as printed.
